svg.title: Regression gates: preserve the contract before claiming a gain
svg.desc: One frozen candidate; four fixed latency claims; all evidence retains its scope
svg.text: Regression gates: preserve the contract before claiming a gain
One frozen candidate; four fixed latency claims; all evidence retains its scope
1. Correctness and safety
Supported family / numerical reference
Exact IDs, draws, lifetime and publication
Any hard failure blocks promotion
2. Valid comparison evidence
20 independent paired sessions per cell
Same inputs, reset and completed boundary
Missing or invalid evidence cannot pass
3. Primary and protected workloads
Primary upper ratio bound ≤ 0.95
Three guard upper bounds ≤ 1.02
One failing guard blocks the overall claim
4. State the decision and its limit
Pass / fail / inconclusive / invalid
Operation gate permits scoped evaluation
Useful service needs its own frozen gate
The interval targets the population median paired-session ratio, not request p99.
A fast wrong result, omitted failure or unqualified workload cannot be averaged away.
